stage: External first-draft feedback; not a native saved scientific review or final record acceptance
scope: All 52 edges and reaction/participant declarations inspected. Chemical sides, Rhea/native mapping, source-local assertions, catalysts, cofactor alternatives, regulatory and experimental endpoint context reviewed. 2020 primary assay/assembly detail checked by its independent source reviewer and communicated during this review; future 2025 GarP context excluded.

findings.problem: The locator cites rh:coefficient for coefficient one, but this Rhea RDF encodes that multiplicity with rh:contains1 on the ReactionSide.
findings.evidence: The complete original-bound rhea-original-projection.json has side contains1 links for every endpoint reaction participant, and each participant resolves by rh:compound to a compound with rh:accession. There is no rh:coefficient property on these selected records.
findings.fix: Locate the exact ReactionSide URI and its rh:contains1 participant link, then the participant compound and compound accession. Do not imply XML nesting where the RDF objects are separately described.

findings.problem: Each reaction-local source_assertion claims the pathway traversal uses left-to-right cleavage, but the cited whole KDGALDOL-RXN reaction only says REVERSIBLE.
findings.evidence: META-KDGALDOL-RXN.xml reaction-direction is REVERSIBLE. GALACTARDEG-PWY.xml reaction-layout for KDGALDOL-RXN has direction L2R and the explicit primary sides.
findings.fix: Restrict the reaction-local assertion to its side/reversibility and add separate GALACTARDEG-PWY reaction-layout direction evidence for physiological traversal.

findings.problem: The selector references[citation.id=Ref.5] does not select the UniProt bibliographic entry.
findings.evidence: P23522 JSON references entry5 has referenceNumber:5 and citation.id:CI-6QDHSLOVEBP3E. Ref.5 is the evidence id, not its citation.id.
findings.fix: Use references[referenceNumber=5] or the exact citation.id. The cofactor assertions and alternatives otherwise match the reviewed annotation.

findings.problem: The qualifier says the Cloning section provides the four-deletion background, but that named background is explicit in Results & Discussion, Figure2 and Table1.
findings.evidence: PMC4378991 Cloning gives the gene-deletion procedure, plasmid procedure, donor spelling and His6-bearing primers; Results & Discussion establishes deletion of both mutases plus garK/glxK, also named in Figure2 and Table1.
findings.fix: Split the section-specific assertion or add Results & Discussion/Figure2/Table1 to the qualifier locator. Product-selection and tag caveats themselves agree with the source.

findings.problem: The paper-only qualifier gives the exact SNA activity-sample remnant and cites Methods4.1,4.4,4.5/Results2.1, but the paper states three residual tag residues in structural material at Methods4.3; the exact SNA sequence is separately established from PDB6U7L.
findings.evidence: Independent 2020 source reviewer /root/next244_source_coverage confirmed paper4.3 p720 for three tag residues, exact SNA in PDB6U7L struct_ref_seq_dif/entitypoly, and no separate sequencing of the assay material. The complex endpoint is supported jointly by native homodimer and paper solution SEC/nativePAGE dimer evidence2.1/Fig2d-e.
findings.fix: Use TEV-cleaved recombinant unlabeled GarD; describe SNA as the structural remnant of the same expression construct with assay-sample scar/phosphorylation occupancy not separately measured. Cite the exact PDB source if retaining SNA, and correct paper locator to4.3. Prefer presence0.5mM versusabsence over ambiguous ±0.5mM.

positive_checks: All four core member IDs, directions and complete pathway chemical sides match the accepted identity audit.
Both Rhea endpoints preserve formal coefficient-one sides; water, pyruvate, proton, ATP and ADP are retained.
Native CPD-26279 stereochemistry and NAD(P) classes are preserved; broader Rhea/UniProt chemistry is explicitly distinguished.
Native GarD homodimer and GarL hexamer catalytic assignments preserve complex-versus-subunit identity.
Native GarR and GarK cross-references bridge correctly to P0ABQ2 and P23524; current gene identifiers match the full UniProt entries.
GarL cofactor annotations retain database-only status and alternative-metal scope.
The 2000 source supports MC4100 expression-level regulation and sdaR autoregulation; no direct ligand-binding claim is introduced.
The 2015 source supports engineered product selection for 2PG; no complete galactarate flux or native assembly claim is introduced.
Taxon assertions distinguish MG1655 native database context from K-12/MC4100 experimental context.

All 30 non-Rhea references in the three inspected original directories matched their whole-original hashes; the 2020 PDF is held by its separate reviewer. Both Rhea references match the already rehashed whole RDF original.
